properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
preparationStatusCode = "500"
preparationMessage = "Workflow input preparation did not complete."
preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": preparationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
escapedOrganizationName = ""
escapedDeviceName = ""
normalizedDeviceType = ""
normalizedServerFormFactor = ""
confirmationAccepted = ""
waitRequested = ""
waitTimeoutSeconds = 0

ORGANIZATION_NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$")

try:
    deviceType = sys.argv[1]
    organization = sys.argv[2]
    deviceName = sys.argv[3]
    serverFormFactor = sys.argv[4]
    confirmText = sys.argv[11]
    waitText = sys.argv[12]
    timeoutText = sys.argv[13]

    escapedOrganizationName = sys.argv[8]
    escapedDeviceName = sys.argv[9]
    errors = []

    if deviceType not in ("Server", "Chassis"):
        errors.append("Device Type must be exactly Server or Chassis.")
    else:
        normalizedDeviceType = deviceType

    if not organization:
        errors.append("Device Organization must not be blank.")
    elif not ORGANIZATION_NAME_PATTERN.fullmatch(organization):
        errors.append("Device Organization must match the current organization.Organization Name schema: 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")

    if not sys.argv[10]:
        errors.append("Device Name must not be blank.")

    if serverFormFactor not in ("Auto", "Blade", "Rack Unit"):
        errors.append("Server Form Factor must be exactly Auto, Blade, or Rack Unit.")
    elif deviceType == "Chassis" and serverFormFactor != "Auto":
        errors.append("Server Form Factor must be Auto when Device Type is Chassis.")
    else:
        normalizedServerFormFactor = serverFormFactor

    if confirmText in ("true", "1"):
        confirmationAccepted = "true"
    elif confirmText in ("false", "0"):
        confirmationAccepted = "false"
        errors.append("Confirm Decommission must be true before any target request.")
    else:
        confirmationAccepted = "invalid"
        errors.append("Confirm Decommission must be a boolean value and must be true.")

    if waitText in ("true", "1"):
        waitRequested = "true"
    elif waitText in ("false", "0"):
        waitRequested = "false"
    else:
        waitRequested = "invalid"
        errors.append("Wait for Completion must be a boolean value.")

    try:
        waitTimeoutSeconds = int(timeoutText)
    except Exception:
        waitTimeoutSeconds = -1
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must be an integer.")

    if waitRequested == "true" and not (1 <= waitTimeoutSeconds <= 600):
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds is required when waiting and must be between 1 and 600 seconds.")
    if waitRequested == "false" and waitTimeoutSeconds < 0:
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must not be negative.")

    if errors:
        preparationStatus = "invalid"
        preparationStatusCode = "400"
        preparationMessage = " ".join(errors)
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Input validation failed", "details": errors}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        preparationStatus = "ready"
        preparationStatusCode = "200"
        preparationMessage = "Device routing, organization, exact-name OData value, and bounded-wait inputs are valid."
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"validated": True, "deviceType": normalizedDeviceType, "serverFormFactor": normalizedServerFormFactor, "confirmDecommission": confirmationAccepted == "true", "waitForCompletion": waitRequested == "true", "waitTimeoutSeconds": waitTimeoutSeconds if waitRequested == "true" else None}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
    preparationStatusCode = "500"
    preparationMessage = str(exc)
    preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Workflow input preparation failed", "detail": preparationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

import json

identityStatus = "helper-failure"

identityMoid = ""

identityItemBase = ""
preAdminActionState = ""
preLifecycle = ""
identitySafetySummaryJson = ""

ADMIN_STATES = {"None", "Applied", "Applying", "Failed", "Scheduled"}
LIFECYCLE_STATES = {
    "None", "Active", "Decommissioned", "DecommissionInProgress", "RecommissionInProgress",
    "OperationFailed", "ReackInProgress", "RemoveInProgress", "Discovered",
    "DiscoveryInProgress", "DiscoveryFailed", "FirmwareUpgradeInProgress",
    "DiagnosticsInProgress", "SecureEraseInProgress", "ScrubInProgress",
    "BladeMigrationInProgress", "Inactive", "ReplaceInProgress", "SlotMismatch",
    "ReplacementPendingUserAction", "Removed", "Moved", "Replaced", "MovedAndReplaced",
    "DomainRmaPendingUserAction", "IdentityUnknown", "RestoreConfigInProgress"
}
BASES = {
    "compute.BladeIdentity": "/api/v1/compute/BladeIdentities",
    "compute.RackUnitIdentity": "/api/v1/compute/RackUnitIdentities",
    "equipment.ChassisIdentity": "/api/v1/equipment/ChassisIdentities"
}

def results_from(text, label, required):
    if not required:
        return []
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        raise ValueError(label + " response body is missing.")
    payload = json.loads(text)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError(label + " response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError(label + " response does not contain a Results array.")
    return results

try:
    bladeBody, rackBody, chassisBody = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
    deviceType, formFactor = sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5]
    expectedName, expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[6], sys.argv[7]

    needBlade = deviceType == "Server" and formFactor in ("Auto", "Blade")
    needRack = deviceType == "Server" and formFactor in ("Auto", "Rack Unit")
    needChassis = deviceType == "Chassis" and formFactor == "Auto"
    if not ((needChassis and not needBlade and not needRack) or (deviceType == "Server" and not needChassis and (needBlade or needRack))):
        raise ValueError("The normalized device routing tuple is inconsistent.")

    bladeResults = results_from(bladeBody, "Blade identity", needBlade)
    rackResults = results_from(rackBody, "Rack unit identity", needRack)
    chassisResults = results_from(chassisBody, "Chassis identity", needChassis)
    combined = bladeResults + rackResults + chassisResults
    count = len(combined)

    if count != 1:
        identityStatus = "cardinality"
        identityStatusCode = "404" if count == 0 else "409"
        identityMessage = "The routed identity lookup returned %d combined matches; exactly one is required." % count
        identityResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Identity lookup cardinality failure", "deviceType": deviceType, "serverFormFactor": formFactor, "bladeMatches": len(bladeResults), "rackUnitMatches": len(rackResults), "chassisMatches": len(chassisResults), "combinedMatchCount": count, "requiredMatchCount": 1}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = combined[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single identity result is not a JSON object.")
        moid = item.get("Moid")
        name = item.get("Name")
        objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
        permissions = item.get("PermissionResources")
        adminState = item.get("AdminActionState")
        lifecycle = item.get("Lifecycle")
        model = item.get("Model")
        serial = item.get("Serial")
        allowedTypes = {"equipment.ChassisIdentity"} if deviceType == "Chassis" else ({"compute.BladeIdentity"} if formFactor == "Blade" else ({"compute.RackUnitIdentity"} if formFactor == "Rack Unit" else {"compute.BladeIdentity", "compute.RackUnitIdentity"}))
        permissionMoidList = [rel.get("Moid") for rel in permissions if isinstance(rel, dict)] if isinstance(permissions, list) else []
        error = ""
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip():
            error = "The matching identity is missing a usable Moid."
        elif name != expectedName:
            error = "The matching identity Name does not equal the requested exact value."
        elif objectType not in allowedTypes:
            error = "The matching identity ObjectType does not match the requested device routing."
        elif expectedOrganizationMoid not in permissionMoidList:
            error = "The matching identity PermissionResources do not contain the resolved organization Moid."
        elif not isinstance(serial, str) or not serial.strip():
            error = "The matching identity is missing a usable Serial required by the pre-mutation safety summary."
        elif not isinstance(model, str) or not model.strip():
            error = "The matching identity is missing a usable Model required by the pre-mutation safety summary."
        elif adminState not in ADMIN_STATES:
            error = "The matching identity AdminActionState is missing or outside the current OpenAPI enum."
        elif lifecycle not in LIFECYCLE_STATES:
            error = "The matching identity Lifecycle is missing or outside the current OpenAPI enum."
        if error:
            identityStatus = "invalid-resource"
            identityStatusCode = "502"
            identityMessage = error
            identityResultJson = json.dumps({"error": error, "deviceType": deviceType, "serverFormFactor": formFactor}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            identityMoid = moid
            identityObjectType = objectType
            identityItemBase = BASES[objectType]
            preAdminActionState = adminState
            preLifecycle = lifecycle
            identityStatus = "ready"
            identityStatusCode = "200"
            identityMessage = "Exactly one identity with the expected returned identity, organization scope, and state fields was resolved."
            identitySafetySummaryJson = json.dumps({"action": "Decommission", "confirmationAccepted": True, "deviceType": deviceType, "serverFormFactor": formFactor, "Moid": moid, "Name": name, "Serial": serial, "Model": model, "ObjectType": objectType, "PermissionResourceMoid": expectedOrganizationMoid, "preActionAdminActionState": adminState, "preActionLifecycle": lifecycle}, separators=(",", ":"))
            identityResultJson = identitySafetySummaryJson
except Exception as exc:
    identityStatus = "helper-failure"
    identityStatusCode = "500"
    identityMessage = str(exc)
    identityResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Identity lookup inspection failed", "detail": identityMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Validates the successful PATCH response as the same identity and organization-scoped resource, checks current AdminActionState and Lifecycle enums, stops on documented failure states, and records whether the response itself proves a state change or explicit progress. HTTP success remains accepted-not-completed.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

acceptanceStatus = "helper-failure"
acceptanceStatusCode = "500"
acceptanceMessage = "Decommission response inspection did not complete."
acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"error": acceptanceMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
acceptanceProgressObserved = "false"

ADMIN_STATES = {"None", "Applied", "Applying", "Failed", "Scheduled"}
LIFECYCLE_STATES = {
    "None", "Active", "Decommissioned", "DecommissionInProgress", "RecommissionInProgress",
    "OperationFailed", "ReackInProgress", "RemoveInProgress", "Discovered",
    "DiscoveryInProgress", "DiscoveryFailed", "FirmwareUpgradeInProgress",
    "DiagnosticsInProgress", "SecureEraseInProgress", "ScrubInProgress",
    "BladeMigrationInProgress", "Inactive", "ReplaceInProgress", "SlotMismatch",
    "ReplacementPendingUserAction", "Removed", "Moved", "Replaced", "MovedAndReplaced",
    "DomainRmaPendingUserAction", "IdentityUnknown", "RestoreConfigInProgress"
}
PROGRESS_ADMIN = {"Applying", "Scheduled"}
PROGRESS_LIFECYCLE = {"DecommissionInProgress"}
FAILURE_LIFECYCLE = {"DiscoveryFailed", "OperationFailed"}

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid, expectedName, expectedObjectType, expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5]
    preAdminState, preLifecycle, deviceType = sys.argv[6], sys.argv[7], sys.argv[8]
    safetySummary = json.loads(sys.argv[9])
    if not isinstance(safetySummary, dict) or safetySummary.get("action") != "Decommission" or safetySummary.get("confirmationAccepted") is not True or safetySummary.get("Moid") != expectedMoid or safetySummary.get("Name") != expectedName or safetySummary.get("ObjectType") != expectedObjectType or not safetySummary.get("Serial") or not safetySummary.get("Model"):
        raise ValueError("The pre-mutation Decommission safety summary is missing or inconsistent.")
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The decommission response body is not a JSON object.")
    moid, name, objectType = item.get("Moid"), item.get("Name"), item.get("ObjectType")
    permissions = item.get("PermissionResources")
    permissionMoidList = [rel.get("Moid") for rel in permissions if isinstance(rel, dict)] if isinstance(permissions, list) else []
    adminState, lifecycle = item.get("AdminActionState"), item.get("Lifecycle")
    error = ""
    if moid != expectedMoid:
        error = "The decommission response Moid does not match the selected identity."
    elif name != expectedName:
        error = "The decommission response Name does not match the selected identity."
    elif objectType != expectedObjectType:
        error = "The decommission response ObjectType does not match the selected identity."
    elif expectedOrganizationMoid not in permissionMoidList:
        error = "The decommission response PermissionResources do not contain the resolved organization Moid."
    elif adminState not in ADMIN_STATES:
        error = "The decommission response AdminActionState is missing or outside the current OpenAPI enum."
    elif lifecycle not in LIFECYCLE_STATES:
        error = "The decommission response Lifecycle is missing or outside the current OpenAPI enum."
    if error:
        acceptanceStatus = "invalid-resource"
        acceptanceStatusCode = "502"
        acceptanceMessage = error
        acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"error": error, "requestMayHaveBeenAccepted": True}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif adminState == "Failed" or lifecycle in FAILURE_LIFECYCLE:
        acceptanceStatus = "operation-failure"
        acceptanceStatusCode = "502"
        acceptanceMessage = "The accepted decommission response already reports a documented failure state."
        acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted": True, "completionVerified": False, "Moid": moid, "Name": name, "ObjectType": objectType, "AdminActionState": adminState, "Lifecycle": lifecycle, "error": acceptanceMessage, "preMutationSafetySummary": safetySummary}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        progressed = adminState in PROGRESS_ADMIN or lifecycle in PROGRESS_LIFECYCLE or adminState != preAdminState or lifecycle != preLifecycle
        acceptanceProgressObserved = "true" if progressed else "false"
        acceptanceStatus = "ready"
        acceptanceStatusCode = "202"
        acceptanceMessage = "Cisco Intersight accepted AdminAction=Decommission; decommission completion has not been verified."
        acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted": True, "completionVerified": False, "deviceType": deviceType, "Moid": moid, "Name": name, "ObjectType": objectType, "preActionAdminActionState": preAdminState, "preActionLifecycle": preLifecycle, "returnedAdminAction": item.get("AdminAction"), "returnedAdminActionState": adminState, "returnedLifecycle": lifecycle, "progressObservedInPatchResponse": progressed, "preMutationSafetySummary": safetySummary}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    acceptanceStatus = "helper-failure"
    acceptanceStatusCode = "500"
    acceptanceMessage = str(exc)
    acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Decommission response inspection failed", "detail": acceptanceMessage, "requestMayHaveBeenAccepted": True}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Validates returned identity and organization data, fails documented failure states, records explicit or changed-state progression, and permits Lifecycle=Decommissioned success only after progression has been proven.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

pollStatus = "helper-failure"
pollStatusCode = "500"
pollMessage = "Decommission state inspection did not complete."
pollResultJson = json.dumps({"error": pollMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
adminActionState = ""
lifecycle = ""
progressObserved = "false"

ADMIN_STATES = {"None", "Applied", "Applying", "Failed", "Scheduled"}
LIFECYCLE_STATES = {
    "None", "Active", "Decommissioned", "DecommissionInProgress", "RecommissionInProgress",
    "OperationFailed", "ReackInProgress", "RemoveInProgress", "Discovered",
    "DiscoveryInProgress", "DiscoveryFailed", "FirmwareUpgradeInProgress",
    "DiagnosticsInProgress", "SecureEraseInProgress", "ScrubInProgress",
    "BladeMigrationInProgress", "Inactive", "ReplaceInProgress", "SlotMismatch",
    "ReplacementPendingUserAction", "Removed", "Moved", "Replaced", "MovedAndReplaced",
    "DomainRmaPendingUserAction", "IdentityUnknown", "RestoreConfigInProgress"
}
PROGRESS_ADMIN = {"Applying", "Scheduled"}
PROGRESS_LIFECYCLE = {"DecommissionInProgress"}
FAILURE_LIFECYCLE = {"DiscoveryFailed", "OperationFailed"}
SUCCESS_LIFECYCLE = {"Decommissioned"}

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid, expectedName, expectedObjectType, expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5]
    preAdminState, preLifecycle, priorProgressText, deviceType = sys.argv[6], sys.argv[7], sys.argv[8], sys.argv[9]
    attempt = int(sys.argv[10])
    safetySummary = json.loads(sys.argv[11])
    if not isinstance(safetySummary, dict) or safetySummary.get("action") != "Decommission" or safetySummary.get("confirmationAccepted") is not True or safetySummary.get("Moid") != expectedMoid or safetySummary.get("Name") != expectedName or safetySummary.get("ObjectType") != expectedObjectType or not safetySummary.get("Serial") or not safetySummary.get("Model"):
        raise ValueError("The pre-mutation Decommission safety summary is missing or inconsistent.")
    if priorProgressText not in ("true", "false"):
        raise ValueError("The prior progression flag is not normalized.")
    priorProgress = priorProgressText == "true"
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The identity polling response body is not a JSON object.")
    moid, name, objectType = item.get("Moid"), item.get("Name"), item.get("ObjectType")
    permissions = item.get("PermissionResources")
    permissionMoidList = [rel.get("Moid") for rel in permissions if isinstance(rel, dict)] if isinstance(permissions, list) else []
    adminState, currentLifecycle = item.get("AdminActionState"), item.get("Lifecycle")
    if moid != expectedMoid:
        raise ValueError("The polled identity Moid does not match the selected identity.")
    if name != expectedName:
        raise ValueError("The polled identity Name does not match the selected identity.")
    if objectType != expectedObjectType:
        raise ValueError("The polled identity ObjectType does not match the selected identity.")
    if expectedOrganizationMoid not in permissionMoidList:
        raise ValueError("The polled identity PermissionResources do not contain the resolved organization Moid.")
    if adminState not in ADMIN_STATES:
        raise ValueError("The polled AdminActionState is missing or outside the current OpenAPI enum.")
    if currentLifecycle not in LIFECYCLE_STATES:
        raise ValueError("The polled Lifecycle is missing or outside the current OpenAPI enum.")

    adminActionState = adminState
    lifecycle = currentLifecycle
    changed = adminState != preAdminState or currentLifecycle != preLifecycle
    explicitProgress = adminState in PROGRESS_ADMIN or currentLifecycle in PROGRESS_LIFECYCLE
    progressed = priorProgress or changed or explicitProgress
    progressObserved = "true" if progressed else "false"
    base = {"requestAccepted": True, "preMutationSafetySummary": safetySummary, "deviceType": deviceType, "Moid": moid, "Name": name, "ObjectType": objectType, "pollAttempt": attempt, "preActionAdminActionState": preAdminState, "preActionLifecycle": preLifecycle, "AdminActionState": adminState, "Lifecycle": currentLifecycle, "progressObserved": progressed}

    if adminState == "Failed" or currentLifecycle in FAILURE_LIFECYCLE:
        pollStatus = "failure"
        pollStatusCode = "502"
        pollMessage = "Device decommission reached a documented failure state."
        base["decommissionCompleted"] = False
    elif currentLifecycle in SUCCESS_LIFECYCLE:
        if progressed:
            pollStatus = "success"
            pollStatusCode = "200"
            pollMessage = "Device decommission progressed and completed with Lifecycle=Decommissioned."
            base["decommissionCompleted"] = True
        else:
            pollStatus = "awaiting-progress"
            pollStatusCode = "202"
            pollMessage = "The identity is in a terminal-looking Lifecycle=Decommissioned state but no post-action progression has been proven yet."
            base["decommissionCompleted"] = False
    elif explicitProgress:
        pollStatus = "in-progress"
        pollStatusCode = "202"
        pollMessage = "Device decommission is in an explicitly documented nonterminal state."
        base["decommissionCompleted"] = False
    elif not priorProgress and not changed:
        pollStatus = "awaiting-progress"
        pollStatusCode = "202"
        pollMessage = "The identity still matches its captured pre-action state; waiting for decommission progression."
        base["decommissionCompleted"] = False
    else:
        pollStatus = "failure"
        pollStatusCode = "502"
        pollMessage = "The changed identity state is neither documented decommission progress, terminal success, nor a documented failure state; polling stopped fail-closed."
        base["decommissionCompleted"] = False
        base["failClosed"] = True
    pollResultJson = json.dumps(base, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    pollStatus = "helper-failure"
    pollStatusCode = "500"
    pollMessage = str(exc)
    pollResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Decommission state inspection failed", "detail": pollMessage, "requestAccepted": True}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Submits disruptive AdminAction=Decommission for exactly one Blade, Rack Unit, or Chassis. Select an intersight.endpoint target authorized to read organizations/identities and update it. Confirm Decommission must be true before target access. Matching is exact and PermissionResources-scoped; explicit Blade/Rack routes query only their collection, while Auto requires one combined match. Identity, lifecycle/action state, and safety summary are validated; PATCH sends only AdminAction=Decommission. Wait=false means HTTP 2xx acceptance only. Wait=true uses a finite 1-600 second schedule and requires progression to Lifecycle=Decommissioned; documented failures fail, known progress continues, and other changed states fail closed. A final GET may finish after deadline. Repeated successful runs can submit the disruptive action again. Generic APIs are used because no complete atomic exists.
